sections.title: OVERWATCH CREDITS LAST CHANCE EVENT
sections.description: The final moment to spend credits on Overwatch seasonal cosmetics is here! Starting September 13 at 11:00 A.M. PDT, we’ll be opening the vault of seasonal unlocks for a last chance to spend credits. Remaining credits will be transferred to Overwatch 2 to use on items in the Hero Gallery. Make sure to grab all your Overwatch seasonal unlock before the event ends October 2!

sections.title: OVERWATCH LEAGUE SUMMER SHOWDOWN
sections.description: Celebrate the Overwatch League Summer Showdown with the Genji Happi legendary skin! This skin is purchasable for a limited time with Overwatch League Tokens.

sections.title: BUGS
sections.description: Resolved a bug with Baptiste's Arctic Ops portrait Fixed an issue where some skins did not display the correct name when localized
